description:
Looking for a place where luxury meets comfort and convenience where you can unwind, recharge, connect and socialize?

Then don't look further! At Newmarket Yards, we are dedicated to crafting an exceptional living experience and we will help you shape the way you live and make it the life you deserve in Dublin's vibrant heart.

Wellbeing at your fingertips, indulge your wellness routine, whatever your mood:

            State-of-the-art gym and yoga studio,

            Fitness-focused rooftop terrace,

            Exclusive outdoor Spa rooftop: sauna, jacuzzi, plunge pool, with City views,

            Lounge / Relaxation room with amazing massage chairs

Work and connect in style in our exceptional co-working area with:

            Private meeting room with video conferencing,

            Individual Zoom Pods,

            Break out spaces,

            Seamless high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity.
 
Socialise and unwind with old and new friends:

            Onsite café,

            Cinema room,

            Games room,

            Residents' lounge with pool table,

            Private dining suite and kitchen,

            5 stunning rooftop terraces with breath-taking 360 degree views and tranquil wildflower gardens, spa terrace with jacuzzi, sauna and plunge pool, Fitness/ Gym Focused terrace, outdoor bar and kitchen and a dedicated dog exercise area,

       Monthly events, gatherings and activities, check out our Community life on our Social Media pages: @newmarketyards

Embrace the city buzz from our prime location.

Dublin is a vibrant mix of history and cool vibes. There's always a fresh discovery around the corner - a trendy bar, a hidden art gallery throughout cobblestone streets. In a nutshell, you'll find:

            Neighbourhood distilleries, restaurants, cafes, and artist studios,

            Explore trendy shops and landmarks live music venues,

            Excellent public transport links - Numerous bus stops at your doorstep,

            Short walk to St. Stephen's Green Park, Christ Church Cathedral and Guinness Storehouse.

At Newmarket Yards, we believe in building for the future. Our A-rated, energy-efficient development is designed with the environment in mind, combining high performance with low impact. As part of our green vision, we offer:

            Electric car charging stations,

            Secure bike storages and a convenient repair station,

            Rooftop beehives to support biodiversity and natural pollination,

            Wildflower gardens across our rooftop terraces,

 
Your dream apartment awaits:

            Spacious, light-filled, and stylish interiors,

            Modern and contemporary apartments across three blocks, reaching the eleventh floor,

            Open-plan kitchen, living, and dining area,

            One or two double bedrooms with built-in wardrobes,

            Main bathroom, en-suite, and storage room,

            High-quality finishes and bespoke fixtures throughout,

            A-rated development,

            Minimum 1 year Lease to make it your home,

            Pet Friendly.


Additional features:

            Bike storage,

            Electric car charging points,

            Limited parking spaces available,

            Pet corner,

            Parcel collection service,

            Resident App and portal,

            Bookable private dining suite and kitchen,

            Bookable cinema room,
 

Unique living awaits at Newmarket Yards. Schedule a viewing and discover a world beyond compare! Contact a member of our team today to arrange a personal viewing and see for yourself!

Live the Newmarket Yards dream: Book your viewing today before it is too late!
